name: pf-mod-partyframes-data
about: mod-partyframes-data against the built packages classes, interface, specs instead of the mods' source folders (tools/generate/make_package_scenarios.py). HWP::AllyStatus on the host: a real Bannerlord shield rises, drops when hit and clears when hit to nothing, and a potion drink and a refill both come back through the relay (a refill is the case vanilla never syncs). Forced setup, solo: a client's path needs two clients, which GameLab can't run.

the refill came back through the relay
